name: @owlauth/server-web
description: Private hosted Runtime and Control browser surfaces embedded by owlauth-server

scripts.contracts:export: mkdir -p ../../../target/openapi && cargo run --quiet --locked --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml --package owlauth-types --bin export-openapi -- runtime ../../../target/openapi/runtime.json && cargo run --quiet --locked --manifest-path ../../../Cargo.toml --package owlauth-types --bin export-openapi -- control ../../../target/openapi/control.json
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run boundaries:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:runtime && pnpm run build:control && pnpm run prepare:assets
scripts.check: pnpm run boundaries:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:scripts
